candidate.answerReason: The median is the 41st score. There are 28 scores in the intervals below 70 and 42 scores through the interval labeled 70, so the 41st score belongs to that interval.

methods.label: Locate the middle score
methods.explanation:
Arrange the \(81\) scores from least to greatest. The median is the \(41\)st score because there are \(40\) scores on each side of that position. We can locate it by adding the histogram counts from left to right.

[Figure 1](figures/1993_AMC_8_Q11_question_fig1.svg)

The intervals labeled \(40,45,50,55,60,65\) contain
\[
1+2+4+5+6+10=28
\]
students altogether. The next interval, labeled \(70\), contains \(14\) students, bringing the total to
\[
28+14=42.
\]
Thus the interval labeled \(70\) contains the \(29\)th through \(42\)nd scores, including the \(41\)st. The median is in that interval, so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
